architecture: 10 input channels; two-convolution GN8-SiLU blocks; widths16/32/64; stride3x3 down, nearest up then3x3 conv; four softmax outputs
prediction_limits: Engineering estimates, not measured runtime/convergence.2000 updates10-100min before evaluation;70min learning cap may truncate. No automatic extension.
measurement: Same-job focused tests assert exact model parameter count. Measure first update and every50 updates; stop if engineering host/GPU peaks exceeded, no separate sizing job.
storage: One final checkpoint, three development role-map HDF5 groups, frozen baseline and compact JSON/PNG. No snapshot or filesystem diagnostics.
